**中文：**
- 更新文件服务核心，修复密码认证下移动/复制及权限边界问题，保留旧浏览器支持。
- 修复工具页复制、空白与末尾换行；自动复制失败时可直接手动复制完整文本。
- 修复 Android 启停、通知剪贴板与恢复状态；损坏设置不再阻止应用启动。
- 改善小屏操作与无障碍；补齐 Windows 运行库、Linux 依赖和 macOS Intel 打包及签名校验。

**English:**
- Updated the file-server core, fixing authenticated move/copy and permission boundaries while retaining older-browser support.
- Fixed tools-page copying, whitespace and trailing newlines, with exact manual recovery when automatic copy fails.
- Fixed Android lifecycle, notification clipboard and restoration; corrupt settings no longer prevent startup.
- Improved small-screen controls/accessibility and Windows runtime, Linux dependency and macOS Intel/signature packaging.
